INSERT INTO articles (title, url, source, published_at, category, summary, content)
VALUES ('{{ $json.title.replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '{{ $json.url.replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '{{ $json.source.replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '{{ $json.published_at }}', '{{ $json.category.replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '{{ ($json.summary || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '{{ ($json.content || '').substring(0, 50000).replace(/'/g, "''") }}')
ON CONFLICT (url) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id, title;

SELECT id, title, url, source, published_at, category, summary
FROM articles
WHERE published_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
ORDER BY published_at DESC;

meta.notes:
## Full Pipeline (Webhook)

Combines RSS ingestion + digest generation into a single webhook-triggered workflow.
Triggered via POST /webhook/pipeline from the app's Refresh Data button.

Returns: { ingested, indexed, digest: { articleCount, markdown } }
